cohort: 141,769 primiparous and multiparous women without a history of Cesarean section and with structurally normal hearts admitted in labor; 76 women with at least one symptomatic SVT episode during pregnancy (study group) and 304 randomly selected controls
finding: SVT during pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of cesarean section and preterm labor in healthy women.
mod_finding: Women with SVT during pregnancy had a higher incidence of Cesarean section (39.5% vs 27.0%)
